locations.name: Reed Ferry Hall
locations.description: An old riverside waiting hall built around a square stone hearth, with timber galleries above the ferry-facing windows.
architecture: Stone hearth in the center of the room
A gallery staircase against the left wall
landmarks: Three tall windows on the river side
A carved reed motif on the central hearth lintel

assets.title: Arrival at Reed Ferry Hall
assets.intended_use: Player location reveal shown before entering the hall
assets.moment: The room rests between ferry arrivals; steam rises from cups near the hearth.

composition.viewpoint: Eye level from the open entrance
composition.framing: Wide interior with the nearest doorway edges partly visible
composition.focal_point: The stone hearth and its carved lintel
composition.depth: Wet threshold foreground, hearth and tables in the middle, pale river windows behind
visible_figures: Two distant seated travelers with indistinct faces

atmosphere.lighting: Warm hearth light across the middle of the hall, cool daylight from the rear windows

art_direction.rendering: Visible brush texture with restrained architectural detail

constraints: The focal hearth must remain fully visible
No baked labels, grid, or interface elements

assumptions: Original demonstration location; neither traveler has an established campaign identity.
gm_notes: The ferry keeper secretly carries a sealed message. This is context only and must not appear in the player illustration.
